description: This file contains a set of utility functions used throughout the SugarCRM-based application, including functions for user permissions, entity retrieval, UI element generation, database caching, and file handling, among others.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the user id belongs to a system administrator.

methods.name: get_select_options
methods.description: Creates HTML options for a select dropdown from an option list, with the specified selected value.

methods.name: get_select_options_with_id
methods.description: Creates HTML options with id as key for a select dropdown.

methods.name: get_select_options_with_value
methods.description: Creates HTML options with value as display string.

methods.name: get_select_options_array
methods.description: Creates HTML options expecting label list and key list as arrays.

methods.name: get_options_array_seperate_key
methods.description: Generates options array with separate label and key arrays, and returns HTML select options.

methods.name: get_select_options_with_id_separate_key
methods.description: Creates HTML options with IDs as keys, with select state handling.

methods.name: get_select_options_with_value_separate_key
methods.description: Creates HTML options with key-value pairs where display string is same as label.

methods.name: parse_calendardate
methods.description: Converts localized date format string to jscalendar format.

methods.name: from_html
methods.description: Decodes special characters, escaping scripts for security.

methods.name: fck_from_html
methods.description: Removes script tags from input string for security.

methods.name: popup_from_html
methods.description: Encodes quotes for popup selection, escaping for safety.

methods.name: fetchCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency id for a user, using cache if available.

methods.name: getCurrencyName
methods.description: Returns the currency name and symbol, optionally as a combined string.

methods.name: get_group_options
methods.description: Fetches all groups as a database result set.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves tab ID for a given module name, with cache support.

methods.name: getFieldid
methods.description: Gets field ID for a given tab and field name, considering active status.

methods.name: getCVname
methods.description: Retrieves custom view name based on custom view ID.

methods.name: getTabOwnedBy
methods.description: Gets the owner type of a module's tab.

methods.name: getSalesEntityType
methods.description: Gets the module name/type for a CRM object based on CRM ID.

methods.name: getAccountName
methods.description: Returns account name given account ID.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns product name given product ID.

methods.name: getPotentialName
methods.description: Returns potential name for a given potential ID.

methods.name: getContactName
methods.description: Returns contact's full name based on contact ID.

methods.name: getLeadName
methods.description: Returns lead's full name based on lead ID.

methods.name: getFullNameFromQResult
methods.description: Constructs full name from a query result row for Contact/Lead.

methods.name: getFullNameFromArray
methods.description: Constructs full name from array of field values.

methods.name: getCampaignName
methods.description: Get campaign name from campaign ID.

methods.name: getVendorName
methods.description: Get vendor name from vendor ID.

methods.name: getQuoteName
methods.description: Get quote subject/title from quote ID.

methods.name: getPriceBookName
methods.description: Get price book name from pricebook ID.

methods.name: getPoName
methods.description: Get purchase order subject from purchase order ID.

methods.name: getSoName
methods.description: Get sales order subject from sales order ID.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns group's name and ID as array from group ID.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Get username by user ID.

methods.name: getUserFullName
methods.description: Get full name of user by ID, considering permissions.

methods.name: getParentName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity's parent record.

methods.name: getURLstring
methods.description: Builds URL query string from focus object's column fields.

methods.name: getValidDisplayDate
methods.description: Returns date in user's formatted date string.

methods.name: getNewDisplayDate
methods.description: Returns today's date in user display format.

methods.name: getDisplayCurrency
methods.description: Gets list of active currencies with symbols for display.

methods.name: convertToDollar
methods.description: Converts amount to USD based on conversion rate.

methods.name: convertFromDollar
methods.description: Converts amount from USD to target currency.

methods.name: convertFromMasterCurrency
methods.description: Converts amount from master currency to local currency.

methods.name: getCurrencySymbolandCRate
methods.description: Returns currency rate and symbol for given currency ID.

methods.name: getTermsandConditions
methods.description: Fetches terms and conditions text for inventory.

methods.name: getReminderSelectOption
methods.description: Creates HTML select for reminder options.

methods.name: getListPrice
methods.description: Fetches list price for a product in a given pricebook.

methods.name: br2nl
methods.description: Replaces newlines, single quotes, double quotes in a string.

methods.name: make_clickable
methods.description: Converts URLs and emails in text into clickable links.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves blocks (UI sections) for a module, detail/edit/create views.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the view type string based on mode.

methods.name: getBlockId
methods.description: Gets block ID based on module tab and label.

methods.name: getHeaderArray
methods.description: Builds nested array of parent-child tab relations.

methods.name: getParentTabName
methods.description: Returns parent tab label for a given parent tab ID.

methods.name: getParentTabFromModule
methods.description: Determines parent tab for a module, via cache or DB.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Fetches the parent tab label from request or module.

methods.name: checkParentTabExists
methods.description: Checks if a parent tab label exists, via cache or database.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Calculates days since last modification of entity and formats info string.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Fetches and prepares product images with script for rotating display.

methods.name: SaveImage
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving of images for products or contacts.

methods.name: file_exist_fn
methods.description: Generates unique filename if file already exists, with increasing prefix.

methods.name: UserCount
methods.description: Returns counts of total, admin, and non-admin users.

methods.name: mkdirs
methods.description: Recursively creates directories with specified mode.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Populates object fields from the HTTP request.

methods.name: create_tab_data_file
methods.description: Exports tab information to a PHP file for caching.

methods.name: create_parenttab_data_file
methods.description: Exports parent tab info to PHP file for caching.
